text:
elaine: Heads up — we need a coordinated docs PR sweep for next week's v1->v2 deprecation window. Primary items: (1) call out param rename (model_id -> model), (2) model swap notes for embed dims, (3) remove most v1 snippets but keep compatibility shim examples behind a feature flag. I opened a meta PR to track: https://git.redwood.dev/r/redwood/docs/pulls/7021 :eyes:

samir: Thanks — can we list owners per file? I'll take the SDK snippets and the TypeScript quickstart (docs/snippets/ts). Putting `docs/needs-review` on PR 7021.

james: I'll own the migration guide section and the redirect map. Will add a small automated redirect JSON under `/static/redirects/v1-to-v2.json`.

maria: I can run smoke tests against the doc-preview site once PRs are up. Please add checklist items for examples that rely on `embed_dim` differences — those need explicit warnings and a fallback recommendation.

elaine: Good call. For embed dims, add this snippet under the migration guide so customers know how to detect and fallback: ```python
# fallback check for embed dim mismatch
if returned_vector.shape[0] != expected_dim:
    # fallback to smaller model or re-embed with the new model id
    use_compatible_model()
```

docs-bot: Reminder: deprecation notice email scheduled for 3 days before sunset (configured in /ops/comm/schedule).

chris: Quick question — are we keeping the v1 API examples in a `legacy/` folder or removing them entirely? Some customers still hit v1 via old SDKs.

elaine: Keep under `legacy/` but add a prominent banner at the top: "Deprecated — use v2. See migration guide." Add a short compat section: how to toggle the compatibility shim (feature flag = `docs.v1_compat_shim`).

liz: I'll draft the banner text. Also can we add a tiny snippet showing the feature-flag usage in the SDK? e.g.: `client = RedwoodClient(feature_flags=["docs.v1_compat_shim"])`

sdk-eng: Note on behavior: the shim will translate old param names to new ones but will not do model dimension conversions. We should explicitly say that in the shim docs to avoid false expectations.

ios-dev: For mobile quickstarts, we need a short blurb about model swap latency differences. I'll add a "performance note" under mobile/quickstart.md.

maria: For the PR queue: can everyone tag PRs with the following labels: `docs/compat`, `impact/high` (if example changes break snippets), and `preview/ready` when deployed to staging? I'll run the smoke tests once I see `preview/ready`.

james: Added a script to generate the redirect map; example mapping format (will add to PR):
```json
[
  { "from": "/v1/generate", "to": "/v2/generate", "status": 301 },
  { "from": "/v1/embeddings", "to": "/v2/embeddings", "status": 301 }
]
```

elaine: Timeline: aim to have all docs PRs opened by EOD Wednesday, review pass Thursday, final merge Friday morning so the deprecation email goes out Friday PM. If you can't meet this, call it out now.

samir: I'll have SDK snippets by Wed noon. Posting one quick concern: the TS streaming example needs a small API change — will add a note in the PR about behavior change and include a migration diff.

liz: Draft banner posted in PR 7021/comment-3. Short copy: "Deprecated — v1 will be turned off on 2026-04-20. Migrate to v2 using the migration guide." Feel free to tweak.

chris: cc @product — can we confirm the actual sunset date to avoid mismatch? last I saw was 2026-04-20.

elaine: Confirmed with product earlier today: 2026-04-20 is the target. I'll sync if that changes.

docs-bot: Automation note: please add `docs:preview` label to each PR to trigger the docs preview build.

maria: Smoke test checklist (short): 1) load migration guide page, 2) run TS/py snippets from preview, 3) confirm redirects work via curl, 4) verify banner appears on legacy pages. I'll paste results in the PR thread.

sdk-eng: One last callout — update the SDK changelog section with a short entry: "Breaking: param rename model_id->model; shim available until 2026-05-20". Keeps expectations clear.

elaine: Great. Owners summary: samir (sdk snippets), james (redirects + migration guide), liz (banner + copy), maria (smoke tests), chris (legacy layout + audits), ios-dev (mobile perf blurb). Ping me for blockers. :rocket:

samir: 👍 starting on TS + Python snippets now.

james: working on redirect script, will attach to PR 7021.

liz: updating banner and adding a short "what changed" bullet list.

maria: will run tests Thursday AM.

elaine: Thanks all — I'll send a short sync note to #product and #support after merges.

chris: Thanks — will scan for any old links that need 301s.

(brief pause)

james: PR 7021 now has the redirect JSON and migration guide stub. Link: https://git.redwood.dev/r/redwood/docs/pulls/7021/files

samir: PR for SDK snippet changes opened: https://git.redwood.dev/r/redwood/js-sdk/pulls/311 — includes migration diff and tests.

maria: Preview builds are green for both PRs. Running smoke tests now.

maria: Smoke test results: all pass except the streaming TS snippet — fails with new callback signature. Marked `impact/high`. Samir, can you push a fix?

samir: On it, pushing a small tests-first fix in a follow-up PR.

elaine: Solid progress. We'll reconvene if anything else pops up. Thanks team!"
